storage: Unopened: cool, dry cupboard until the date on the pack. Opened: move to a clean, covered glass or steel container and keep in the fridge; use within 2–3 days. The fat may set on top in the cold; stir or warm gently. Leftovers can be frozen in small portions for cooking.
looksLike: A thick, creamy, pure white liquid sold in small tetra packs (usually 200 ml) or tins (usually 400 ml). When the pack is opened, the top may be a thicker cream layer over thinner milk; shaking the pack mixes them.
shelfLife: StoreKing gives 270 days unopened for Dabur Hommade; check the pack date.
substitutes: Fresh coconut milk pressed at home

usedIn.raw: 70 ml in total (40 ml thick milk to finish the stew + 30 ml mixed with 70 ml water as thin milk)
